description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Bolts, Washers and Nuts for the the Exhaust Manifold COVER.
The Cover is the two-piece part that goes around the exhaust manifold.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Bolts
Qty 3 – Lock Washers
Qty 3 – Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
